rationale: events.json requires level_i delivery with a 20 ns minimum, >= 1.5 x 10 ns, on an unreset sampler l1_q: CDC-013(c) INFO Heuristic. dst_hold_q's synchronous reset is contracted and all ports are covered.

author_reading.rationale: Required level held 20 ns (>= 2x the 10 ns sampling clock) on a non-resettable two-stage sampler that feeds a hold register: delivery margin exceeds 1.5 periods.

labels.rationale: The required 20 ns level assertion exceeds the 15 ns review margin. Both synchronizer stages are reset-free. Only the consumer has a synchronous reset and it reads a single completed stage.

Primary input level_i (launched on src_clk) is sampled by an unreset 2-stage synchronizer (l1_q -> l2_q) in dst_clk (period 10.0 ns) before feeding synchronously reset register dst_hold_q. In events.json, level_i has required delivery with a 20 ns minimum duration (>= 1.5x the 10.0 ns dst_clk period = 15.0 ns) on a sampler without reset, earning CDC-013 INFO Heuristic with no warning.
